title: Saudi Arabian Lamb Kebabs
description: A flavorful and aromatic dish featuring marinated lamb kebabs grilled to perfection, inspired by the cuisine of Saudi Arabia.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, lemon juice, garlic, ginger, cumin, coriander, paprika, salt, and black pepper.
Add the lamb cubes to the marinade and mix well to coat. Cover and refrigerate for at least 2 hours or overnight.
Preheat a grill or grill pan to medium-high heat.
Thread the marinated lamb cubes onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Grill the kebabs for 8-10 minutes per side, or until cooked to your desired level of doneness.
Let the kebabs rest for 5 minutes before serving.
Serve hot with your favorite sides, such as rice, flatbread, or salad.
